description: SwiftUI view for QR code scanning using VisionKit and custom DataScannerViewController, handling recognized QR codes and errors.

classes.name: Coordinator
classes.description: Delegate class handling QR code recognition and error reporting for QRScannerView.

methods.name: makeUIViewController
methods.description: Creates and configures the DataScannerViewController for QR code scanning.

methods.name: dismantleUIViewController
methods.description: Stops scanning and dismisses the scanner view.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Creates the Coordinator instance for handling delegate callbacks.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Reports an error message to the parent view.

methods.name: dataScanner(_:didAdd:allItems:)
methods.description: Handles recognized QR code items, parses for gateway links or setup codes.

methods.name: dataScanner(_:didRemove:allItems:)
methods.description: Handles removal of recognized items (empty implementation).
